narration_lines: Why We Stay Out of Floodwater
A swimming pool and a flooded road both have water. Are they the same? No. Floodwater can have dangers we cannot see.
Moving water can be much stronger than it looks. Even people who can swim should stay out of floodwater.
Floodwater hides the bottom. You cannot always see where your next step will land.
Floodwater can hide branches, metal, rubbish and broken things that can hurt us.
Water from roads, drains, rubbish and muddy soil can mix together. Floodwater can carry dirty water and germs.
If water reaches damaged electrical things, stay away and tell a grown-up.
Floods can make animals leave their usual homes. We do not touch them. We tell a grown-up.

Water where it should not be? Stay out. Something fell in? Tell a grown-up. Electrical thing near water? Stay away. Need to go somewhere? Stay with your grown-up. Floodwater does not have to look scary to be dangerous.
